_comment: Monorepo: Laravel API in apps/api (Docker), Flutter app in apps/mobile (host). {FILES} paths start at the repo root (apps/api/...), but PHPStan runs inside the container from apps/api, so phpstan:changed uses a project script that takes {BASE} and strips the prefix.

commands.test: docker compose -f "./apps/api/docker-compose.yml" exec laravel.test php artisan test --compact 2>&1
commands.test:filter: docker compose -f "./apps/api/docker-compose.yml" exec laravel.test php artisan test --compact --filter={FILTER} 2>&1
commands.migrate: docker compose -f "./apps/api/docker-compose.yml" exec laravel.test php artisan migrate --force 2>&1
